institution: Vignan's Foundation for Science, Technology and Research (VFSTR), Deemed-to-be University
data_policy: Official-source-backed requirements; no invented institutional compliance values. Missing operational data is marked EVIDENCE_PENDING.

records.evidence_required: Current curriculum/transcript audit
records.notes: R26 states 160 graduating credits + 10 compulsory binary grade credits; up to 16 add-on credits are optional.

records.requirement_name: Maximum credits registered per regular semester
records.evidence_required: Semester registration records
records.notes: R26 states maximum 25 credits per semester including add-on credits.

records.requirement_name: Minimum instructional days in regular semester
records.evidence_required: Approved academic calendar + attendance/calendar records
records.notes: Summative assessment days are excluded.

records.evidence_required: Curriculum course L-T-P-SL structure
records.notes: Use for automated curriculum/contact-hour consistency checks.

records.evidence_required: Course timetable + curriculum L-T-P-SL data
records.notes: Core rule for laboratory/contact-hour compliance.

records.evidence_required: Course files / syllabus repository
records.notes: R26 also requires COs to be mapped to relevant POs.

records.evidence_required: Approved syllabus/course file
records.notes: R26 also specifies 2–3 reference books per course.

records.evidence_required: Approved syllabus/course file
records.notes: Automate syllabus-resource completeness check.

records.evidence_required: Attendance management system
records.notes: R26 says attendance compliance should be 75% or within condonable range; otherwise R grade.

records.evidence_required: Internal/formative marks database
records.notes: Failure results in R grade.

records.evidence_required: End-semester assessment database
records.notes: Failure results in I grade.

records.evidence_required: Laboratory manual + publication/schedule record
records.notes: Manual must include equipment list, procedures, record format, learning outcomes and relevant short questions.

records.required_value: Regular faculty fulfilling prescribed faculty-student and cadre ratios
records.evidence_required: Program-wise sanctioned/required faculty + appointment status + ratio calculation
records.notes: Do not hard-code one ratio here; applicable AICTE table must be selected by program/level.

records.required_value: 1 Professor with PhD per PG course; alternatively at least 1 Associate Professor with PhD if Professor unavailable
records.evidence_required: PG program faculty roster + qualification records
records.notes: Applies to postgraduate courses, not as a blanket B.Tech PhD-ratio rule.

records.required_value: Faculty meet applicable UGC minimum qualification requirements
records.evidence_required: Faculty qualification, degree, eligibility/NET/SET/PhD records as applicable
records.notes: Do not represent this as a universal >=40% PhD rule; applicability depends on post and current UGC provisions.

records.source_document: UGC Curbing the Menace of Ragging Regulations 2009 + amendments
records.required_value: Required anti-ragging prevention/compliance mechanisms in place
records.evidence_source: VFSTR Anti-Ragging page + UGC regulations listing
records.evidence_required: Committee composition, policy, undertakings, awareness, complaint mechanism, reports
records.notes: VFSTR publishes an Anti-Ragging Committee and related policy/mechanisms. Website evidence should still be refreshed periodically.

records.source_document: UGC (Redressal of Grievances of Students) Regulations 2023
records.required_value: Grievance redressal mechanism and committee evidence maintained
records.evidence_source: VFSTR grievance page + UGC regulations listing
records.evidence_required: SGRC composition, minutes, complaint records, closure reports
records.notes: Use evidence freshness/meeting cadence as the actual automated check.

records.required_value: Accreditation status tracked program-wise with validity dates
records.evidence_required: NBA accreditation certificate/order and validity period per program
records.notes: VFSTR page lists engineering programs with 2023–26 and 2026–28 accreditation periods; Agent 54 should track each program separately.

records.source_document: NBA UG Engineering Tier-I accreditation guidance
records.required_value: Use applicable NBA ratio for the accreditation cycle (commonly 25:1 for 3-year / 20:1 for 6-year in cited guidance)
records.evidence_required: Program-wise student and faculty data + accreditation cycle
records.notes: Do not use a single university-wide ratio. Resolve the applicable NBA cycle/program rule before calculating status.

records.required_value: For applicable six-year accreditation guidance, available PhD faculty >=30% of required number, averaged over two academic years
records.evidence_required: Two-year program faculty roster + PhD qualification records + required faculty calculation
records.notes: This is an accreditation-cycle criterion, not a blanket UGC rule. Verify against the exact current NBA manual/cycle.

records.requirement_name: NBA library and learning resources evidence
records.required_value: Program-level learning-resource evidence maintained and current
records.evidence_source: VFSTR Library page + NBA accreditation framework
records.evidence_required: Books/titles, journals/e-resources, usage, adequacy, digital resources and program evidence
records.notes: Do not hard-code '10 students per title' unless the applicable NBA/other official source explicitly requires that threshold.

records.evidence_required: Library management system export / stock verification
records.notes: Website states more than 1,20,100 volumes; treat as a snapshot, not an accreditation threshold.

records.evidence_source: VFSTR institutional committees and anti-ragging pages
records.evidence_required: Current committee order/composition + meeting records
records.notes: VFSTR lists Anti-ragging Committee among institutional committees and publishes current committee information.

records.evidence_required: Current orders, member lists, meeting minutes and action taken reports
records.notes: The page lists committees including IQAC, Internal Complaints, Library Advisory, Student Grievance, Anti-Ragging, Discipline and others.

records.required_value: Resolve from applicable AICTE/NBA CSE rule
records.evidence_required: CSE student count + required/available faculty + applicable regulator rule
records.notes: FSR-CSE-001 is an internal application ID, not an official regulation identifier.

records.source_document: Agent 54 internal control mapped to R26
records.required_value: Matches applicable ECE curriculum and R26 credit rules
records.evidence_required: ECE curriculum, semester registration and credit distribution
records.notes: CRED-ECE-001 is an internal application ID; the R26 credit rules are the authoritative source.
